description: The money would boost housing production, create a new state agency, help fund existing homeless shelters and give cities a one-time chance to bypass state land-use laws to build housing.

title: Federal warrant issued in north Tulsa homeless camp murder
description: Tulsa Police have identified the suspect in a north Tulsa shooting that left one man dead and one woman injured.
